title: The commit-msg hook's KB-Work refusal names the comma that separates several item ids
goal: When the commit-msg hook or check-trailers refuses a KB-Work trailer that lists several ids with spaces, its message says the ids are separated by ', ' on one line (as 'BG-a, ST-b'), so a planning commit that confirms several items' gates is fixed in one amend. In SP-6ukmjucf the confirm commit was refused twice: once for naming the review story it did not change, once for space-separated ids, with a message that only said 'expected one line of backlog item ids'.
notes: SP-6ukmjucf retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
